**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Resolve defaults against the held run identity**

When a legacy pre-1.4 chain omits `model` and `ctx_limit`, changing an identity field such as `run_id` makes `load_chain()` derive those tunable defaults from the newly named run directory. Copying every value from `new` then silently changes the dashboard from the legacy defaults (`None`/300k) to the new-run defaults (Opus/200k), even though the identity edit is supposedly ignored; the displayed context threshold can therefore disagree with the running watcher. Preserve defaults from the held configuration for omitted tunables, or load defaults using the original run identity.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve positive sub-second durations**

For valid positive fractional settings below half a second, such as `handoff_timeout_minutes: 0.001`, `round(value * 60)` produces zero and the notification again says `0 мин`. Since configuration validation permits any positive finite timeout, this leaves part of the regression the new formatter is intended to fix; clamp a positive duration to at least one second or reject values below the supported display precision.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Retry the identity-change event after a logging failure**

When `events.log` is temporarily unwritable (for example during a transient permission or filesystem error), `_IDENTITY_TOLD` is updated before `wab.event()` succeeds. The exception is then suppressed, and subsequent frames see the same signature as already reported, so this identity change is never recorded even after logging recovers. Mark the signature only after the event has been written successfully so the promised notification is retried without failing the frame.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
